intent: Revert the spread to the race 2 value (±0.03 m, 15 mm pitch) and keep 16 mm footprints, which were the best-scoring geometry (356.98). Move the sensor lead forward from y = 0.05 to y = 0.06, the only change against race 2, to test the Integrator's oscillation rule on the oval track. I expect oval steering_oscillation to fall below about 0.25 and oval finishes to hold near 12 to 15 of 20. I expect s-bend and slalom to remain off-track, because the geometry is not their limiter; if they still lose the line at max_error near 0.06, the Integrator should tune kp, kd and base_speed. I am considering a wider spread again only if a later race shows the spread is limiting s-bend and slalom, and I am not committing to that now.
learning: Race 3 showed that ±0.04 m reduced oval finishes from 15 to 5 of 20 and did not reduce s-bend or slalom line loss (1.0 and 1.15 events). The spread is therefore not the limiter for s-bend and slalom, and ±0.03 m is the best measured spread. Next race: if oval steering_oscillation falls below 0.2 with y = 0.06, the forward lead helped and should be kept. If oval finishes drop below race 2 levels, the lead move cost reach and y should return to 0.05. If s-bend and slalom still show line_loss at 1 or more with max_error at 0.06, the remaining cause is controller gain or base_speed.
rationale: Race 3 (entityR2A, score 235.88) widened the outer spread to ±0.04 m with 16 mm footprints. That was worse than race 2 (356.98, ±0.03 m, 16 mm). Oval finishes fell from 15/20 to 5/20, and oval max_error rose to 0.057. On s-bend and slalom, line loss stayed at 1.0 and 1.15 events with max_error at the 0.06 m limit, so the wider spread did not fix the failure it was meant to fix. The Integrator's own rule says that when line loss stays at 1 or more with max_error at the limit, the spread is no longer the limiter and the geometry should be held. Oval steering_oscillation is 0.32 in race 3 and 0.31 in race 2, above the 0.2 threshold the Integrator set for moving the sensors forward. I am therefore reverting the spread to ±0.03 m, the best measured spread, and keeping 16 mm footprints. I am making one change against the race 2 baseline: the lead moves from y = 0.05 to y = 0.06 to test whether the forward lead reduces oval oscillation. This departs from the Integrator's request to keep ±0.04 m. I am declining that request because race 3 showed ±0.04 m costs oval finishes without fixing s-bend or slalom. The lead move is the only geometry change, so any change in oval oscillation can be attributed to it. I expect oval steering_oscillation to fall below about 0.25 and oval finishes to stay near race 2 levels (about 12 to 15 of 20). I do not expect s-bend or slalom to finish from geometry alone, so I am leaving controller gain and base_speed to the Integrator.
